title.narrative: Support for Community Violence Reduction (MINUSCA) in Bangui, Central African Republic

description.narrative: The United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in the Central African Republic (MINUSCA) Disarmament, Demobilization and Reintegration (DDR) Section intends to undertake a phase 9 of the community violence-reduction project in Bangui, focused on multi-track interventions, including key social and economic reinsertion components and a civilian disarmament component, targeting elements associated with armed groups non-eligible to the DDR process, members of the community, in particular youths prone to violence and recruitment into armed groups and self-defense groups. UNOPS is the implementation partner of MINUSCA.
